source: Top-side copper, solder mask, silkscreen, drill and placement data converted from the BeagleBoard rev C5 manufacturing files (https://github.com/beagleboard/BeagleBoard), by Gerald Coley of BeagleBoard.org, CC BY-SA 3.0.
